verdict.rationale: Several documentation URLs contain a '/api/v1/' path segment, which hints at URL-based versioning. However, no evidence item describes a versioning scheme, version lifecycle, or any deprecation or sunset policy. The core of the story, a documented deprecation policy, has no evidence, and a version number in a URL alone does not establish it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
